svg.title: RAG PDF Genie: ask a 115-page IRS PDF questions with a fully local LLM
svg.desc: Isometric pipeline inside an offline boundary: a 115-page IRS PDF is split into chunks, embedded with nomic-embed-text and stored in a ChromaDB vector store drawn as a rotating 3D lattice. A question fans out into rewritten queries (multi-query retriever) whose beams retrieve matching vectors; llama3.2 running in Ollama writes an answer grounded only in the retrieved context. No API keys; models are pulled once, then everything runs on the machine.
svg.text: Ask a 115-page IRS PDF questions with a fully local LLM. No API keys; the document never leaves the machine.
OFFLINE BOUNDARY · NO API KEYS · NOTHING LEAVES THE MACHINE
